_comment: Round two of the UI/HUD resolution scaling work from docs/ui_scaling.md - fix 3, the one the
first pass deliberately left alone. tools/build.py merges every data/ported_*.json into
data/ported.json before it compiles, so this file and the sources below are one unit: if a
build rejects either, both belong in wip/ together.
?Create@gfxBitmap@@SAPAV1@PAVgfxImage@@_N@Z  -> code/midtown2/gfx/gfxbitmap.cpp
Resamples a decoded UI image to the screen scale before the surface is built, so
gfxBitmap::Width and Height report the scaled size and the ~40 still-assembly callers that
lay out from them follow along untouched.
?CopyBitmap@gfxPipeline@@SAXHHPAVgfxBitmap@@HHHH_N@Z -> code/midtown2/gfx/gfxpipeline.cpp
Unchanged BltFast for every caller whose source rectangle fits its bitmap. A rectangle that
does NOT fit is rejected outright by BltFast today and draws nothing - that is asUnderlay::Cull
and the missing menu background at 1440p - so it is read as a destination extent and stretched.
BOTH ARE ALREADY PRESENT IN data/ported.json, so merge_ported will report them as duplicates.
That message is about a second REGISTRATION, not a second definition, and nothing is lost:
merge_ported starts from data/ported.json and skips what it has already seen. This file was
written, merged by a concurrent build, and then went missing from data/ while that build ran;
it is restored here because the registration and the sources are supposed to travel together,
and because data/ported.json is the shared file this work is not supposed to own. If the
duplicate warning is unwanted, deleting THIS file is safe today and only costs the record.
Progress and open gaps: docs/ui_scaling_progress.md.
